title: Recordkeeping.
bodyText: Insurers, managing general agents, independent agencies, and producers shall maintain or make available to the commissioner records of the information collected from the consumer; disclosures made to the consumer, including summaries of oral disclosures; and other information used in making the recommendations that were the basis for insurance transactions for five years after the insurance transaction has been completed by the insurer. An insurer may maintain documentation on behalf of a producer.
bodyHtml: §431:10D-625  Recordkeeping.  Insurers, managing general agents, independent agencies, and producers shall maintain or make available to the commissioner records of the information collected from the consumer; disclosures made to the consumer, including summaries of oral disclosures; and other information used in making the recommendations that were the basis for insurance transactions for five years after the insurance transaction has been completed by the insurer.  An insurer may maintain documentation on behalf of a producer. [L 2007, c 257, pt of §2; am L 2022, c 58, pt of §7]
